entities.name: PMID:27492913
observations: Population-based Olmsted County, Minnesota cohort studied incident type 1 diabetes from 1994 through 2010.
Included 233 incident cases across all ages.
Overall incidence was 9.2 per 100,000 person-years (95% CI 8.0–10.4); incidence under age 20 was 19.9 per 100,000 person-years (95% CI 16.6–23.2).
Poisson regression found no significant temporal increase (P=.45); incidence initially rose then plateaued.
